quote: Anthropic 於 1 日發布新一代旗艦模型 Claude Fable 5.1 與 Claude Mythos 5.1
note: Lab (Anthropic) and kind (shipped) confirmed. The quote is in Chinese; it translates as 'Anthropic released its new flagship models Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 on the 1st'. The page is dated 2 September 2026, and the quote was extracted with WebFetch, not copied from raw page text. Anthropic's own page (https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-1) is dated only 'September 2026' and says 'Claude Fable 5.1 is available today on all platforms' and 'Fable 5.1 is generally available, while Mythos 5.1 is available only through our trusted access programs', so it confirms the month and general availability but not the day. The day 1 is corroborated by news.smol.ai's issue dated Sep 01 covering 8/31/2026-9/1/2026, and by secondary sources (Happycapy, llmgateway.io, a Manifold market page) that give September 1; the Happycapy page is promotional. No limited preview of Fable 5.1 was found, so preview_date is null. Mythos 5.1 is a separate model with restricted trusted access and is not the subject of this record. One low-quality source describing Fable 5.1 as creative-focused contradicts the other reports and was discounted.
